mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN maintenance_worker mw ON mw.id = wo.accepted_worker_id AND mw.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = mw.user_id AND u.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT wo.id, wo.order_no, wo.title, wo.status, AS activity_time, u.real_name AS worker_name FROM work_order wo
ORDER BY activity_time DESC, wo.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT wo.status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM work_order wo
GROUP BY wo.status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.accepted_worker_id) + COALESCE(MAX(wo.accepted_worker_id IS NULL), 0) FROM work_order wo

SELECT u.real_name AS worker_name, mw.worker_no, COUNT(*) AS total FROM work_order wo
GROUP BY wo.accepted_worker_id, u.real_name, mw.worker_no ORDER BY total DESC, wo.accepted_worker_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.real_name AS work_name, mw.worker_no, mw.work_status, mw.current_load, COALESCE(assigned.pending, 0) AS pending
ORDER BY mw.current_load DESC, mw.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT mw.work_status, COUNT(*) AS total
GROUP BY mw.work_status ORDER BY mw.work_status
